## Affected Area or Resource
- [ ] Main README (`README.md` / `README.en.md`)
- [ ] Internal module documentation (`core/`, `flask_ext/`, `mail/`, etc.)
- [ ] Integration examples (`examples/`)
- [ ] Docstrings or type hints in source code

## Description of Inquiry or Inconsistency
Explain in detail what section is confusing, what information is missing, or which instruction is outdated.

## Behavior or Example Attempted
Code snippet, configuration, or command executed as documented:
```python
# Code or instruction executed
```

## Suggested Improvement
Proposed wording, complementary usage example, or recommended technical fix.

## Additional Context
Any additional references, links, or screenshots providing clarity to the report.
